# Migration Plan — Sprint Branch → Main → Production

**Branch:** `claude/plan-zuri-sprint-2oywV` → `main`
**Sprints covered:** 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8
**Date:** 2026-04-20
**Risk level:** 🟡 MEDIUM — schema migration required, no downtime expected

---

## 1. Pre-Deploy Checklist

### Database (Supabase / PostgreSQL)
- [ ] **Backup production database** — Supabase Dashboard → Database → Backups → Manual backup
- [ ] **Verify `DIRECT_URL` env var** is set on production (Vercel)
- [ ] Confirm no long-running queries blocking schema changes

### Environment Variables (Vercel → Project Settings)
- [ ] `BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET` — `openssl rand -hex 32` (NEW)
- [ ] `NEXTAUTH_SECRET` — already present, reused for mobile JWT
- [ ] `DIRECT_URL` — required by Prisma migrate (separate from pooled `DATABASE_URL`)

### Code
- [ ] Pull latest `main` and confirm no merge conflicts (currently 0 commits behind)
- [ ] CI tests pass on PR #57 (vitest 604/604)
- [ ] Lint passes (`npm run msp:check`)

## 2. Database Migration

### 2.1 Schema changes summary

**14 new models added:**
| Model | Domain | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `Invoice` | Billing | Replaces ad-hoc invoice JSON |
| `AdHourlyMetric` | Marketing | 24×7 ad heatmap data |
| `CampaignBroadcast` | Marketing | FEAT-016 broadcast queue |
| `CampaignLog` | Marketing | Per-recipient delivery log |
| `DeliveryZone` | POS | FEAT-012 fee zones |
| `DeliveryDriver` | POS | FEAT-012 driver roster |
| `DeliveryOrder` | POS | FEAT-012 state machine |
| `AutomationWorkflow` | Workflow | FEAT-014 trigger→action graphs |
| `AutomationExecution` | Workflow | FEAT-014 run history |
| `AutomationCooldown` | Workflow | FEAT-014 throttling |
| `AIChatHistory` | AI | FEAT-011 chat persistence |
| `AIPendingEntry` | AI | FEAT-011 confirmation queue |
| `MarketPrice` | Kitchen | Daily ingredient cost feed |
| `PrepSheet` | Kitchen | Daily prep recommendations |

**Modified models:**
- `Tenant` — 9 new relation fields (one-to-many to new tables above)
- `Employee` — `email @unique` → `email` + `@@unique([email, tenantId])` (ADR-081)
- `Customer` — added `optOut Boolean`, `lastCampaignAt DateTime?`

**Index changes:**
- New compound unique on `Employee(email, tenantId)` — replaces single-column unique
- All new models have `@@index([tenantId])`

### 2.2 Migration command

```bash
# On a machine with prod DATABASE_URL + DIRECT_URL set:
npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss=false
```

> ⚠️ Project does NOT use `prisma migrate` — uses `db push` (single source of truth from schema.prisma).
> If you want a versioned migration file: `npx prisma migrate dev --name sprint8_consolidated --create-only` then commit the SQL.

### 2.3 ADR-081 email migration safety

The change `email @unique` → `@@unique([email, tenantId])` is **safe** when:
- ✅ No existing Employee.email duplicates across tenants (verify with query below)
- ✅ All app code goes through `findByEmail(email, tenantId)` from `employeeRepo`

**Pre-migration check (run in Supabase SQL editor):**
```sql
SELECT email, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM employees
GROUP BY email
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
If `cnt = 0` → safe to migrate. If duplicates exist → impossible per current `@unique` constraint anyway.

### 2.4 Rollback plan

Schema rollback (if needed within 1 hour of deploy):
```bash
git checkout main -- prisma/schema.prisma
npx prisma db push
```
Then redeploy old commit. **Note:** new tables retain data; only constraints/columns revert.

For data rollback → restore from Supabase backup (Step 1).

## 3. Code Deploy

### 3.1 Vercel auto-deploy
Merging `claude/plan-zuri-sprint-2oywV` → `main` triggers Vercel preview → production build automatically.

Build steps (Vercel runs):
1. `npm install` (picks up new deps: `husky`, `@testing-library/*`, `jsdom`, `@vitejs/plugin-react`)
2. `npx prisma generate` (regenerates client for 14 new models)
3. `next build`

**Estimated build time:** 4–6 minutes (vs current ~3 min) due to new test infra deps.

### 3.2 Smoke tests (post-deploy)

| Endpoint | Expected | Critical |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /` | 200, dashboard loads | 🔴 |
| `POST /api/auth/mobile-login` | 401 invalid creds, 200 valid | 🔴 |
| `POST /api/webhooks/billing` (no sig) | 401 if `BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET` set | 🟡 |
| `GET /api/marketing/dashboard` | 200, KPI JSON | 🟡 |
| `GET /pos` (mobile UA) | 307 redirect → `/pos/mobile` | 🟡 |
| `GET /pos` (desktop UA) | 307 redirect → `/pos/tables` | 🟡 |
| `GET /manifest.json` | 200, PWA manifest | 🟢 |

### 3.3 Real-time verification

- Open dashboard → trigger employee status change → confirm Pusher event in browser console
- Send test campaign → verify QStash worker logs in Vercel logs

## 4. Mobile App Deploy (Expo) — Optional

Mobile app at `mobile/` does **NOT** affect web deploy. Deploy separately:

```bash
cd mobile
npm install
npx expo install --fix
eas build --platform ios     # requires EAS account
eas build --platform android
```

Set `mobile/app.json` → `expo.extra.apiUrl` to production URL before build.
